Service, Every Step
Meet Your Local Expert

Hi, I'm Blaze Beasley

I still remember the first time I walked through the streets here. There was something about this place—the church bells in the morning, the colorful streets, the people. Life just moved a little more intentionally. What started as a new adventure quickly became home.

Living here has given me the chance to experience San Miguel beyond the postcards—wandering through different neighborhoods, discovering hidden cafés, watching sunsets over the city, and getting to know the people who make this place so special. Every neighborhood has its own personality, and one of my favorite parts of this job is helping people discover which one feels like home to them.

I know buying a home in another country can feel exciting, but it can also feel overwhelming. My goal is to make that journey as simple and enjoyable as possible by offering honest advice, local knowledge, and guidance you can trust from our first conversation to closing day.

Whether you're relocating, searching for a vacation home, or investing in San Miguel de Allende, I'd love the opportunity to help you discover why so many people fall in love with this city—and help you find a place where you can build your own story.

"I moved to San Miguel at eighteen and never looked back. Now I get to help other people fall for this city the way I did."
Moved to San Miguel at 18 and fell in love with the city
Still exploring every street, neighborhood, and hidden corner
